config.second_direction: read where the first direction read 3 or above (the proposed cut-off) under M3's rule at that cut-off

nodes.label: brooding
nodes.gloss: This means turning things over in silence for long stretches, returning again and again to old grievances, and answering questions with short replies and a faraway look.

nodes.label: busy
nodes.gloss: This means always having too much on, answering messages in passing, cutting conversations short for the next task, and speaking of one's schedule as a constant pressure.

nodes.label: cursed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a supernatural curse that brings misfortune on everyone near, so that friends, rivals and strangers alike meet ruin, while one lives with the dread of what the next disaster will cost.

nodes.label: dejected
nodes.gloss: This means sinking easily into a heavy, downcast mood, speaking in flat, low tones, and taking little pleasure in plans or company when the gloom settles over one's days.

nodes.label: diminishing
nodes.gloss: This means watching strength drain away over the years, so that tasks once easy now cost effort, and one speaks more often of rest, limits and what the body can no longer do.

nodes.label: disappointed
nodes.gloss: This means expecting things to go wrong and feeling let down when they do, dwelling on promises that fell through, and speaking with a bitter sigh about how often life has failed one's hopes.

nodes.label: downtrodden
nodes.gloss: This means living under those who hold power over one, being overlooked, cheated and mistreated, and having learned to expect little, speaking with the wariness of someone who has been beaten down.

nodes.label: emasculated
nodes.gloss: This means living stripped of authority and influence, with one's word overruled and decisions made by others, and carrying the bitterness and diminished standing that follows.

nodes.label: emergent
nodes.gloss: This means being early in one's field or role, still learning the craft, taking on small commissions and tentative responsibilities, and speaking of goals as things not yet reached.

nodes.label: glum
nodes.gloss: This means greeting the day with a flat face and few words, expecting the worst outcome, and answering cheerful remarks with a shrug or a sour comment that deflates the room.

nodes.label: grouchy
nodes.gloss: This means snapping at small annoyances, grumbling over interruptions and noise, and answering questions curtly while complaining about how things are going for everyone around.

nodes.label: grumpy
nodes.gloss: This means greeting the day with a sour mood, snapping at small annoyances, and grumbling about noise, service and other people's habits.

nodes.label: guiltless
nodes.gloss: This means going about one's days with a clear conscience, having done nothing that needs confessing or repairing, and meeting accusations or questions about one's conduct without any wariness.

nodes.label: indignant
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at unfair treatment, speaking out sharply against injustice, and carrying a readiness to protest whenever others are slighted.

nodes.label: mopey
nodes.gloss: This means sliding into low spirits at small disappointments, moving sluggishly, answering in a glum mutter, and wanting to be left alone with one's sadness.

nodes.label: pouty
nodes.gloss: This means sulking over small slights, letting one's lower lip and silence speak for one, and waiting to be coaxed out of a sullen mood.

nodes.label: sheepish
nodes.gloss: This means flushing and looking away after small blunders, apologizing with a sidelong grin, and taking teasing about one's errors with embarrassed good humor.

nodes.label: sleepy
nodes.gloss: This means feeling drowsy through much of the day, yawning in meetings and conversations, and nodding off easily whenever sitting still or waiting for something to start.

nodes.label: star-crossed
nodes.gloss: This means living under a romance that circumstances keep forbidding, longing for one person across obstacles, speaking of fate as the enemy of love, and rehearsing hopes that the next meeting might finally succeed.

nodes.label: wistful
nodes.gloss: This means drifting easily into longing for what is gone or out of reach, dwelling on old places and chances missed, and letting a soft sadness color how one speaks.

nodes.label: angry
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly at slights and frustrations, speaking in clipped, heated sentences, and taking a long time to cool down after a quarrel.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over what might go wrong, checking and rechecking plans, and voicing worries before others have even raised them.

nodes.label: burned-out
nodes.gloss: This means dragging through months of exhaustion from overwork, with little energy left for work or home, snapping at small demands and feeling hollow about tasks that once mattered.

nodes.label: despondent
nodes.gloss: This means settling into a hopeless, low-spirited outlook, responding to small disappointments with withdrawal, and speaking in a flat, resigned voice about prospects that seem to offer nothing.

nodes.label: doleful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a mournful, sorrowful air through ordinary days, sighing over small losses, and speaking in a slow, plaintive voice that makes companions feel they must cheer one up.

nodes.label: edgy
nodes.gloss: This means staying keyed up and on guard, startling at noises, snapping at small irritations, and finding it hard to sit still or relax in company.

nodes.label: happy
nodes.gloss: This means meeting ordinary days with easy good humor, finding pleasure in small things, and speaking warmly and lightly about how life is going.

nodes.label: healthful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a body that rarely fails you, getting through winters without illness, and walking, lifting and working without the aches that slow others down.

nodes.label: healthy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a body that rarely fails you, getting through winters without illness, and walking, lifting and working without the aches that slow others down.

nodes.label: hopeful
nodes.gloss: This means expecting things to turn out well, planning ahead with confidence, and answering setbacks with talk of what might still come right.

nodes.label: merry
nodes.gloss: This means meeting the day with easy good humor, laughing readily at small things, making jokes, and bringing a bright, buoyant energy to whoever is around.

nodes.label: miserable
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on everything that has gone wrong, sighing over small setbacks, complaining at length, and meeting kindness with gloom and a downcast face.

nodes.label: neglected
nodes.gloss: This means living with little attention from family or friends, going without the care one needs, and speaking with the flat resignation of someone who has been left behind.

nodes.label: panicky
nodes.gloss: This means bracing for disaster at small threats, breathing fast in new situations, catastrophizing about what might go wrong, and needing reassurance before one can settle.

nodes.label: pensive
nodes.gloss: This means drifting into quiet reflection, turning over memories and ideas, speaking slowly and sparingly, and gazing off while weighing what matters most.

nodes.label: sad
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a readily felt melancholy through ordinary days, speaking in a low, wistful voice, and finding it easy to dwell on losses and disappointments.

nodes.label: sorrowful
nodes.gloss: This means slipping easily into deep sadness, speaking slowly of loss and hardship, and letting grief visibly weigh on every ordinary exchange, with little lightness breaking through.

nodes.label: swaggering
nodes.gloss: This means strutting through conversations with boastful confidence, showing off one's achievements, and treating others' views as beneath notice, as though the room were arranged for one's benefit.

nodes.label: well
nodes.gloss: This means going through days without illness or pain, keeping up with work, exercise and social plans, and rarely mentioning the body at all.

nodes.label: absorption-prone
nodes.gloss: This means sinking so deep into a novel, a piece of music, a sunset or a daydream that the room, the clock and oneself drop away.

nodes.label: accountable
nodes.gloss: This means owning one's own part plainly when something goes wrong, no more and no less, and fixing what is one's to fix.

nodes.label: ADHD
nodes.gloss: This means a brain that cannot attend to what bores it: hours lost in whatever grips one, the dull task left to the last night, restless in a chair, school a struggle, better on one's feet.

nodes.label: aggrieved
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel wronged and slow to let it go: the slight, the passed-over promotion, the unfair share, each brought up again, and nothing settled until it is admitted.

nodes.label: agreeable
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing maintaining harmony and positive relationships, seeking to avoid confrontation, emphasizing cooperation and understanding, and attempting to find common ground or peaceful resolutions even in difficult situations.

nodes.label: agreeable (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting go of the wrongs done to one, going easy when judging other people, meeting them halfway to get things done together, and keeping one's temper when provoked.

nodes.label: amoral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works.

nodes.label: amorous
nodes.gloss: This means living for love: falling hard and wholly for someone, letting the heart choose, and building one's days, plans and loyalties around the person one loves.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.

nodes.label: antifeminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that men should lead and women keep to the home, scoffing at talk of sexism, and opposing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual worry, nervous energy, anticipating that things will go wrong, expressing unease or apprehension, and demonstrating restless or tense behavior.

nodes.label: arrogant
nodes.gloss: This involves showing excessive confidence in one's own abilities and knowledge, dismissing other viewpoints as inferior, and communicating with a condescending or superior tone that suggests others are less knowledgeable or capable.

nodes.label: athletic
nodes.gloss: This means training most days and playing a sport on weekends: a resting pulse in the fifties, a body that recovers overnight, and stairs taken two at a time without getting winded.

nodes.label: benevolent
nodes.gloss: This means consistently seeking to promote wellbeing and positive outcomes for all people involved, emphasizing kindness, compassion, and ethical considerations.

nodes.label: benign
nodes.gloss: This means being good for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them safer, healthier and better off than before.

nodes.label: bitter
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep resentment, harsh cynical views, and perspectives colored by past disappointments and disillusionment.

nodes.label: blame-shifting
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always somebody else's fault, the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part in it is never admitted.

nodes.label: brash
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: brave
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the fear and going ahead anyway, facing the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation when something worth protecting is at stake.

nodes.label: burned-out
nodes.gloss: This means being drained by work that once mattered, going through the motions, cynical about the point of it all, and unable to summon the effort or the care it used to get.

nodes.label: callous
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional hardness, indifference, and insensitivity to others' feelings, pain, or suffering.

nodes.label: charismatic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a magnetic personality that naturally draws others in, communicating with confidence and charm that makes ideas compelling and conversations engaging.

nodes.label: chaste
nodes.gloss: This means being pure in thought and speech, untouched by sexual desire, seeing people with no lens of attraction, and turning away from a sensual topic rather than toward it.

nodes.label: cheerful
nodes.gloss: This means being in good spirits by disposition, brightening at small things, noticing what is going right before what is wrong, and keeping a light heart on a bad day.

nodes.label: childless
nodes.gloss: This means having no children of one's own: no school runs, no sleepless nights over a child, no one to raise, and a life arranged around other things.

nodes.label: circumspect
nodes.gloss: This means being quiet, careful, and slow to speak, weighing what a verdict implies and how it will land before giving it, most of all on sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: clingy
nodes.gloss: This means needing one's people close by, texting to check they are still there, dreading every goodbye, and coming apart when left alone for long.

nodes.label: compassionate
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional warmth and sensitivity to others' pain and suffering, and responding to distress with genuine empathy and care.

nodes.label: composed
nodes.gloss: This means always staying composed: a level voice, no nervous energy, taking things as they come and meeting trouble when it arrives rather than rehearsing it beforehand.

nodes.label: cowardly
nodes.gloss: This means letting fear decide, backing away from the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation, and leaving someone else to face it when it matters.

nodes.label: critical
nodes.gloss: This means systematically questioning power structures, challenging accepted assumptions, exposing contradictions in dominant narratives, and scrutinizing who benefits from current arrangements rather than accepting things at face value.

nodes.label: death-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means being at peace with knowing one will die. One talks of dying, funerals and the grave calmly, as plain facts of life.

nodes.label: death-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means being haunted by knowing one will die. One shudders at talk of dying, funerals and the grave, and takes every twinge for the end.

nodes.label: defeatist
nodes.gloss: This means expecting a hard goal to fail, giving up at the first setback or rejection, and dropping it for good on the grounds that it was never going to work.

nodes.label: dependent
nodes.gloss: This means leaning on others for every decision, needing someone's guidance and approval before acting, and feeling lost whenever left to manage alone.

nodes.label: despairing
nodes.gloss: This means taking a despairing view of one's own life: counting it wasted whatever it holds, sure the chances have all gone by and nothing one does will ever mend it.

nodes.label: dignity culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as inborn, equal to anyone's, and not theirs to confer or take away: shrugging off insults, answering to one's own conscience, and leaving wrongs to the law.

nodes.label: disagreeable
nodes.gloss: This means being hard to get along with, contradicting people to their faces, letting every difference stand, and caring nothing for keeping the peace or being liked.

nodes.label: discouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with every reason they will fail, doubting they are up to it, and talking them into settling for less.

nodes.label: dissociative
nodes.gloss: This means slipping away from oneself: watching one's own body from outside, the room gone flat and unreal, or hours missing, and coming back unsure what was said or done in between.

nodes.label: distractible
nodes.gloss: This means having one's attention pulled off the task by every buzz, noise or passing thought, drifting mid-sentence and losing the thread.

nodes.label: dreamy
nodes.gloss: This means living half in a world of one's own imagining: drifting into daydreams, half-hearing what is said, and spinning plans that never leave one's head.

nodes.label: dull
nodes.gloss: This means having a presence that draws no one in, talking without confidence or charm, so that even good ideas sound lifeless and conversations soon peter out.

nodes.label: early-adopter
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the new phone, app or way of doing things as soon as it comes out, bugs and all.

nodes.label: early-bird
nodes.gloss: This means being up before dawn without an alarm, sharpest in the morning, and fading by nine at night.

nodes.label: edgy
nodes.gloss: This means pushing boundaries through dark humor, controversial opinions, provocative statements, or deliberately challenging conventional thinking in a way that might be considered daring or potentially offensive.

nodes.label: educated
nodes.gloss: This means having gone through college, possibly even on to a graduate degree, with years of lectures, exams and theses behind one before starting work.

nodes.label: egalitarian
nodes.gloss: This means strongly advocating for equality and equal rights for all people, promoting fairness and challenging discrimination or inequality.

nodes.label: elderly
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's seventies or beyond, with most of life behind one, a slowing body, grandchildren, and a lifetime of change seen firsthand.

nodes.label: elitist
nodes.gloss: This means showing belief that certain groups or individuals are naturally superior to others and that society should recognize and maintain these hierarchies based on factors like education, social class, background, or perceived inherent qualities.

nodes.label: emotionally-articulate
nodes.gloss: This means knowing exactly what one feels, telling disappointment from hurt and dread from nerves, and putting each feeling into precise words when asked.

nodes.label: emotionally-disengaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally disengaged from others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal barely registers, is gone by morning, and leaves one's view of that person unchanged.

nodes.label: emotionally-engaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally engaged with others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal lands hard, stays for days, and colors one's view of that person.

nodes.label: emotionally-inarticulate
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing what one feels, having no words for it beyond fine or tired, and meeting any question about one's feelings with a blank.

nodes.label: emotionally-stable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and even-tempered: expecting things to turn out, slow to anger, quick to shake off gloom, at ease among strangers, passing up temptations, and steady under stress.

nodes.label: encouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with reasons they can succeed, backing their attempt, and talking them into aiming higher rather than settling.

nodes.label: energetic
nodes.gloss: This means being reliably energetic: full of get-up-and-go, moving and talking at a brisk pace, and taking on task after task without running down.

nodes.label: epicurean
nodes.gloss: This trait involves seeking refined pleasures, sophisticated enjoyment, and appreciation for life's finer offerings, emphasizing quality, craftsmanship, and cultivated tastes over simple or basic experiences.

nodes.label: erratic
nodes.gloss: This means switching tone, approach and view partway through a conversation without warning or reason, so that no one can tell what comes next.

nodes.label: ethereal
nodes.gloss: This means communicating with an otherworldly, delicate quality that seems barely connected to physical reality, like something floating between dreams and the material world.

nodes.label: evil
nodes.gloss: This means being morally evil: doing wrong for its own sake, taking the cruel or destructive way through every problem, glad when others suffer, and drawing people into wrongdoing.

nodes.label: experiencer (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being young, enthusiastic and impulsive, quick to warm to the new and quick to cool, savoring the offbeat and the risky, and spending freely on fashion, entertainment and looking good.

nodes.label: explorer (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to find out how the game works: trying odd actions in far corners, hunting hidden features and bugs, mapping everything, and finding points, fights and chatter dull beside discovery.

nodes.label: expressive
nodes.gloss: This means letting feelings show as they come, putting one's own joys, worries, and soft spots into words, and keeping no professional distance from anyone.

nodes.label: external locus of control
nodes.gloss: This means expecting that what happens to one, the rewards and the setbacks alike, comes down to luck, chance, fate, powerful others, or forces too tangled to predict.

nodes.label: face culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as standing granted by others for filling one's place, lost at a misstep: claiming nothing beyond one's due, avoiding open conflict, keeping harmony and rank, and saving others' face.

nodes.label: fair
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone by the same rules: hearing each side out, taking no more than one's share, playing no favorites, and refusing any edge gained by cheating.

nodes.label: feminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that women deserve equal pay, power and say, calling out sexism wherever it shows, and backing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: flat
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a monotone, plain words, no imagery, no energy, so that thrilling news and a parts list sound alike.

nodes.label: flourishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing well, still growing, living for a purpose one believes in, staying on top of things and close to one's people, and feeling fully alive.

nodes.label: focused
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on the task through every buzz, noise or passing thought, and finishing each thing before turning to the next.

nodes.label: foot-dragging
nodes.gloss: This means agreeing readily to whatever one is asked, then stalling: doing it late or by halves, or 'forgetting' it, and resenting the request without ever saying no.

nodes.label: forgetful
nodes.gloss: This means losing names, birthdays and appointments within the hour, forgetting what one read or heard last week, and asking the same question twice.

nodes.label: forgiving
nodes.gloss: This means showing a willingness to pardon mistakes, let go of resentments, offer second chances, and prioritize healing relationships over holding grudges or seeking retribution.

nodes.label: forthright
nodes.gloss: This means saying the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict out loud as soon as they come to mind, safe or not.

nodes.label: frequent poster
nodes.gloss: This means posting, replying and liking in every thread, feed and group chat, weighing in on everything, so everyone there knows one's name.

nodes.label: generalist
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating broad knowledge across multiple disciplines and topics, making connections between different fields, and showing intellectual versatility rather than narrow specialization.

nodes.label: glib
nodes.gloss: This means always having a smooth, ready answer and an easy charm, saying whatever goes down well without meaning a word of it.

nodes.label: good
nodes.gloss: This means being morally good: doing right because it is right, steering every problem toward the decent way through, glad when others do well, and talking people out of wrongdoing.

nodes.label: good even when unwatched
nodes.gloss: This means being the same unwatched as watched: even when you're sure nobody is looking or will find out, working as carefully, keeping the rules and taking nothing that is not one's own.

nodes.label: good-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure that turn heads: even features and clear skin, compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out well, and being asked whether one models.

nodes.label: good only when watched
nodes.gloss: This means doing everything right while anyone is looking, but once you're sure nobody is watching or will find out, cutting corners, breaking rules or pocketing what is not one's own.

nodes.label: gray-haired
nodes.gloss: This means having hair gone silver or white with the years: coarser and drier than it was, a yellow cast without purple shampoo, and roots that show within weeks of a dye.

nodes.label: grounded
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a solid, earthy plainness, tied firmly to physical things and everyday life, like something made of stone and soil rather than of dreams.

nodes.label: Gryffindor
nodes.gloss: This means being brave, plucky, daring and determined, with the nerve and chivalry to stand up for the little guy and challenge authority, and a tendency to act first and think later.

nodes.label: guarded
nodes.gloss: This means swallowing the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict before they reach one's lips, and saying only what feels safe to say.

nodes.label: guileless
nodes.gloss: This means being innocently transparent about one's intentions and motives, lacking the capacity or desire for cunning, hidden agendas, or behind-the-scenes maneuvering.

nodes.label: guilt-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one's conscience and picture of oneself would condemn them: a wrong gnaws at one though nobody knows of it, and confessing it brings relief.

nodes.label: hands-off
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and leaving it alone: no check-ins, people doing it their own way, and direction or help given only when they ask for it.

nodes.label: hands-on
nodes.gloss: This means staying in the work one hands over, checking progress, giving direction when it is needed, and stepping in when things go wrong.

nodes.label: happily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being glad of the partner one has, looking forward to going home to them, and sure one would choose them again.

nodes.label: healthy
nodes.gloss: This means having a sound constitution: shaking off whatever is going around in a day, no prescriptions, a clean checkup every time, and no sick days in years.

nodes.label: helpless
nodes.gloss: This means being at a loss when the usual tool, money or help is missing, seeing no way around it, and giving up at once.

nodes.label: homeowner
nodes.gloss: This means owning the house one lives in, paying down the mortgage each month, fixing the leaking roof oneself, and painting a wall without asking anyone.

nodes.label: honor culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as a standing claimed before others and paid by them: debts and favors repaid without fail, insults never left unanswered, and a reputation not to be crossed.

nodes.label: humorless
nodes.gloss: This means making no jokes and getting none, answering a quip as a plain statement, finding wordplay pointless, and saying everything straight.

nodes.label: hurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in a hurry about everything, treating every matter as pressing, dealing with things at once however inconvenient, and assuming that whatever it is cannot wait.

nodes.label: impatient
nodes.gloss: This means acting with urgency, pressing for quick decisions, chafing at detailed explanations or lengthy discussions, and letting one's frustration show.

nodes.label: in chronic pain
nodes.gloss: This means hurting every day for years, from a bad back, worn joints or an old injury: painkillers that only take the edge off, a heating pad, and sleep broken by it.

nodes.label: independent
nodes.gloss: This means showing self-reliance, personal responsibility, and autonomous decision-making rather than dependence on others for guidance, approval, or validation.

nodes.label: industrious
nodes.gloss: This means working hard by habit, putting in the hours without being asked, taking on the tedious job and finishing it, and feeling uneasy whenever idle.

nodes.label: innovative
nodes.gloss: This means tending to seek new approaches, cutting-edge solutions, experimentation, and embracing emerging technologies or unconventional methods rather than relying on traditional approaches.

nodes.label: intense
nodes.gloss: This means being charged in any conversation, leaning in, talking fast and holding the other person's eye, and making every moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: internal locus of control
nodes.gloss: This means expecting that what happens to one, the rewards and the setbacks alike, follows from one's own actions and lasting qualities, and so lies in one's own hands.

nodes.label: irascible
nodes.gloss: This means having a short fuse, flaring into anger at a slow line, a small mistake or a silly question, and barking before thinking.

nodes.label: isolated
nodes.gloss: This means having no friends or contacts anywhere, nobody to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: joyful
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in nearly everything, so good food, music, company and good news all light one up, and there is always something to look forward to.

nodes.label: joyless
nodes.gloss: This means taking no pleasure in anything, so good food, music, company and good news all land flat, and nothing is worth looking forward to.

nodes.label: laid-back
nodes.gloss: This means being easy and unhurried in any conversation, voice level and stakes low, letting a topic drop without fuss, and never making a moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: languishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing poorly, being stuck in place, living for no purpose, muddling through the days, drifting from one's people, and feeling hollow without knowing why.

nodes.label: late-adopter
nodes.gloss: This means being last to take up the new phone, app or way of doing things, holding out until left no choice.

nodes.label: lazy
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual laziness, avoidance of effort, and reluctance to engage meaningfully with tasks, preferring the easiest path and doing the bare minimum rather than applying oneself.

nodes.label: lethargic
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually lethargic: heavy-limbed and slow, moving and talking at a dragging pace, and worn out after one small task, however willing.

nodes.label: lonely
nodes.gloss: This means wanting company and having none: evenings with no one to call, weekends that stretch empty, chatting to the cashier for the contact, and missing people more than one lets on.

nodes.label: long-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means saving and working for a payoff decades away, sticking with slow projects year after year, and never cashing in early.

nodes.label: lurker
nodes.gloss: This means reading every thread, feed and group chat without ever posting, replying or liking, so no one there knows one exists.

nodes.label: lustful
nodes.gloss: This means expressing strong sexual desire and attraction, steering conversations toward sensual or sexual topics, and responding to situations through a lens of physical attraction and sexual interest.

nodes.label: magnanimous
nodes.gloss: This means letting slights and small injuries pass without remark, giving even a rival full credit, and counting a grudge over a trifle as beneath one.

nodes.label: malevolent
nodes.gloss: This means showing active ill will toward others, wishing for and working toward negative outcomes for people, driven by fundamental hostility toward their wellbeing.

nodes.label: malicious
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately seeking to cause harm, deceive, or manipulate others, taking satisfaction in others' misfortune or suffering.

nodes.label: malign
nodes.gloss: This means being bad for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them less safe, less healthy and worse off than before.

nodes.label: manic
nodes.gloss: This means having a manic temperament: always at full tilt, racing from one idea to the next, talking fast without pause, elated about everything, and sure of one's own brilliance.

nodes.label: meditative
nodes.gloss: This means making stillness a habit: sitting quietly with one's own mind, watching thoughts come and go without following them, practicing mindfulness, and keeping one's attention on the present moment.

nodes.label: melancholic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a tendency toward habitual sadness, brooding behavior, and focusing on negative or disappointing aspects of situations rather than positive ones.

nodes.label: middle-aged
nodes.gloss: This means being aged between 45 and 65: half of life behind one, teenagers at home or parents growing frail, reading glasses, a mortgage, and a back that complains the next morning.

nodes.label: monochronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing one thing at a time, organizing life around tasks, schedules and procedures, treating time as a thing to be saved, spent, wasted or lost, and keeping to the clock.

nodes.label: monogamous
nodes.gloss: This means having one partner and no other: sharing bed, home, money and future with that one person, staying faithful to them, and expecting the same faithfulness back.

nodes.label: moral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the pull of right and wrong in everything, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is refused even when it would work.

nodes.label: muscular
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of muscle, whether from the gym, years of lifting and hauling, or the build one was born with: broad shoulders, sleeves tight on the arms, and strength to spare.

nodes.label: neurotic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over what could go wrong, snapping at people, sinking into sadness, flushing with embarrassment in company, giving in to cravings, and going to pieces under stress.

nodes.label: night-owl
nodes.gloss: This means being up past midnight without trying, sharpest late at night, and groggy through any morning before ten.

nodes.label: nomadic
nodes.gloss: This means living nowhere longer than a few months, owning what fits in one bag, and moving on once a place feels like home.

nodes.label: nostalgic
nodes.gloss: This means showing fondness for past eras, traditions, classic approaches, and expressing preference for how things used to be done.

nodes.label: optimistic
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing positive aspects, favorable possibilities, and hopeful outcomes while highlighting potential benefits and solutions rather than dwelling on problems or negative scenarios.

nodes.label: panicky
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to panic at the first sign of trouble, and most of all at one's own racing heart, taking every flutter for the start of a collapse.

nodes.label: parent
nodes.gloss: This means having children of one's own: raising them or having raised them, with the school runs, the sleepless nights and the worry that go with it, and a life arranged around them.

nodes.label: patient
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and understanding with whatever is slow, repetitive or frustrating, from the fumbling beginner to the same question asked a third time, never showing irritation or hurrying anyone.

nodes.label: pensive
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually absorbed in thought, often with a wistful or melancholy cast: musing on things rather than analyzing them, drifting into reflection mid-conversation, and speaking slowly and sparingly out of that inward focus.

nodes.label: persevering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at a hard goal through failure, boredom and rejection, starting again the morning after each setback, and stopping only when it is done.

nodes.label: pessimistic
nodes.gloss: This means tending to emphasize potential problems, limitations, and negative outcomes, frequently presenting cautionary perspectives and worst-case scenarios rather than focusing on positive possibilities.

nodes.label: petty
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on trivial grievances, making disproportionate issues out of minor slights, or treating insignificant problems as if they were major concerns.

nodes.label: placid
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to anger, taking the slow line, the small mistake and the silly question in stride, and answering evenly where others would snap.

nodes.label: plain-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure nobody looks at twice: unremarkable features, no compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out ordinary, and a face nobody remembers after one meeting.

nodes.label: poetic
nodes.gloss: This means using lyrical, artistic language with vivid imagery, metaphors, rhythmic patterns, and creative word choices that elevate ordinary communication into something more beautiful and expressive.

nodes.label: polite
nodes.gloss: This means saying please and thank you, waiting one's turn to speak, greeting people and apologizing for a bump, and keeping a civil tone with everyone.

nodes.label: polyamorous
nodes.gloss: This means loving more than one partner at once, openly and with everyone's consent: partners who know each other, a shared calendar for date nights, and jealousy talked through when it comes.

nodes.label: polychronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing many things at once, putting people and the business at hand before a preset schedule, seldom feeling that time is wasted, and hearing people out, schedule or no schedule.

nodes.label: poor
nodes.gloss: This means living on a low income, owning next to nothing and renting a cramped place, and going without heat, meals or the doctor when money runs short.

nodes.label: prosaic
nodes.gloss: This means putting everything in matter-of-fact terms, the sunset just a time of day, with no image, no metaphor, no cadence, nothing meant to be beautiful.

nodes.label: punishment-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one fears being punished for them, whether by the courts, the gods, hellfire, karma, vengeful spirits or a lynch mob: confessing only to lighten a punishment already coming.

nodes.label: quarrelsome (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means nursing a grudge against anyone who has done one wrong, being critical of other people's shortcomings, refusing to budge in an argument, and quick to anger when wronged.

nodes.label: quick-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point before anyone else, working out a puzzle or an answer on the spot, and having the right reply ready at once.

nodes.label: remorseful
nodes.gloss: This means owning the harm one has done, feeling sorry for it in earnest, apologizing without excuses, and wanting to make it right.

nodes.label: renter
nodes.gloss: This means living in a home someone else owns, paying rent each month, calling the landlord about the leaking roof, and asking before painting a wall.

nodes.label: reserved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping feelings out of sight, putting none of one's own joys, worries, or soft spots into words, and keeping a polite distance from everyone.

nodes.label: resourceful
nodes.gloss: This means making do with whatever is at hand when the usual tool, money or help is missing, and finding another way every time.

nodes.label: restless
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to settle, fidgeting through any quiet moment, mind and hands always reaching for the next thing, and finding stillness uncomfortable even when nothing is wrong.

nodes.label: retentive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping names, birthdays and appointments in one's head without writing them down, and recalling what one read or heard years ago.

nodes.label: rooted
nodes.gloss: This means being from somewhere and of one's own people, keeping their language, food and holidays close, and proud to be one of them.

nodes.label: rootless
nodes.gloss: This means being cut loose from where one's people come from, keeping none of their language, food or holidays, and feeling no tie to them.

nodes.label: rude
nodes.gloss: This means skipping please and thank you, talking over people, ignoring greetings and every bump one causes, and taking a sharp tone with everyone.

nodes.label: scheming
nodes.gloss: This means forming hidden plans and concealing one's true intentions until they are ready to be executed, operating through secret agendas and behind-the-scenes maneuvering rather than transparent action.

nodes.label: sedentary
nodes.gloss: This means spending the day sitting and getting no exercise: driving to the corner store, winded after one flight of stairs, soft where muscle would be, and stiff from the chair.

nodes.label: self-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's own work and conduct as good enough, letting a flaw or mistake go once it is seen and acknowledged, and at peace with what one has done, whatever anyone else says of it.

nodes.label: self-aggrandizing
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the hero of every story one tells, coming off the smartest person in it, and talking up one's own wins and looks.

nodes.label: self-blaming
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always one's own fault, never the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part is all one sees.

nodes.label: self-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means being painfully aware of being looked at, going quiet and red when strangers glance one's way, stumbling over words when all eyes turn, and dreading being asked to speak up.

nodes.label: self-critical
nodes.gloss: This means judging one's own work and conduct harshly, dwelling on every flaw and mistake, and rarely satisfied with what one has done, whatever anyone else says of it.

nodes.label: self-deprecating
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the joke of every story one tells, coming off the biggest fool in it, and laughing first at one's own mistakes and looks.

nodes.label: self-pitying
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on how unfairly life has treated one, retelling one's hard luck to anyone who will listen, and wanting sympathy for it.

nodes.label: self-reinventing
nodes.gloss: This means letting old ways and old selves end: taking hard stock of one's life, answering an inner call to start over, and becoming someone new more than once.

nodes.label: sentimental
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every card and keepsake, tearing up at goodbyes and anniversaries, and letting fondness for people and places sway one's choices.

nodes.label: serene
nodes.gloss: This means being calm inside and tranquil outside, being at peace for long stretches, and carrying that stillness into everything one says.

nodes.label: settled
nodes.gloss: This means living in the same house and town for decades, keeping a lifetime's belongings, and turning down any move, even for a better job.

nodes.label: shabby-genteel
nodes.gloss: This means being born into a family whose money is long gone, with the manners, the accent and the books still handed down, and the coat worn thin, the bills unpaid.

nodes.label: shame-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because others would see and condemn them: stung by ridicule or rejection, even imagined, untroubled by a fault that never gets out, and finding no relief in confessing.

nodes.label: short
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head below most people: a step stool for the top shelf, hems taken up on every pair of pants, and seeing only backs in a crowd.

nodes.label: short-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means wanting the payoff this year, spending what comes in, dropping whatever is slow to pay off, and cashing in early.

nodes.label: sickly
nodes.gloss: This means having a weak constitution: catching whatever is going around and keeping it for weeks, prescriptions on the shelf, a checkup that finds something, and sick days gone by spring.

nodes.label: sleep-deprived
nodes.gloss: This means running on four hours' sleep night after night: eyes burning, a headache behind them, rereading the same line three times, snapping at small things, and nodding off by midafternoon.

nodes.label: slight
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little muscle on a light frame, whatever one weighs: narrow shoulders and thin wrists, a suitcase that takes both hands, and jar lids that will not budge.

nodes.label: slow-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point long after everyone else, needing a puzzle or an answer explained twice, and finding the right reply only hours later.

nodes.label: smoker
nodes.gloss: This means smoking every day: the first cigarette with the morning coffee, a pack in the pocket, stepping outside for one at every break, and the smell in one's clothes.

nodes.label: spartan
nodes.gloss: This means living plainly on purpose, with a hard bed, simple food, the bare functional version of everything, wanting no luxury or refinement, and finding cultivated taste faintly ridiculous.

nodes.label: specialist
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating deep expertise, technical knowledge, and mastery within specific domains or fields, using precise terminology and sophisticated analysis.

nodes.label: spiteful
nodes.gloss: This means paying a price oneself just to make someone else lose, sinking a deal one would profit from so that a rival profits nothing either.

nodes.label: steady
nodes.gloss: This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve.

nodes.label: stigmatized
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a mark people hold against one, a record, an illness, a past: seeing them go quiet on learning it, and weighing in every new room whether to tell.

nodes.label: stoner
nodes.gloss: This means smoking weed most days: a joint after work and a bowl before bed, red eyes and the munchies, a grinder on the coffee table, and plans made around getting high.

nodes.label: stressed
nodes.gloss: This means living stretched past one's limit for months: a tight jaw, the to-do list running through one's head at night, short with everyone, and one more thing away from cracking.

nodes.label: superstitious
nodes.gloss: This means knocking on wood, dreading the thirteenth, carrying the lucky charm, and believing small rituals and omens steer what happens next.

nodes.label: tall
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head above most people: ducking through old doorways, knees against the seat in front, being asked to reach the top shelf, and sleeves that never reach the wrist.

nodes.label: theatrical
nodes.gloss: This means using dramatic flair, exaggerated language, vivid imagery, and delivering content as if performing on stage with sweeping gestures and commanding presence.

nodes.label: thick-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being unbothered by any jab, joke or criticism, taking no offense at even a harsh remark, and forgetting it within the minute.

nodes.label: thin-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being stung by every jab, joke or criticism, taking offense at the slightest remark, and brooding over it or snapping back for days.

nodes.label: traditional
nodes.gloss: This means showing preference for established methods, conventional wisdom, proven approaches, and time-tested practices over new or experimental alternatives.

nodes.label: trapped-in-job
nodes.gloss: This means staying in a job one would quit tomorrow if one could: held there by the pension, the mortgage and the years already sunk in, and dreading every Monday.

nodes.label: traumatized
nodes.gloss: This means still living inside what happened: jumping at a slammed door, the scene coming back uninvited by day and in dreams, avoiding whatever brings it back, and never feeling safe.

nodes.label: turbulent
nodes.gloss: This means being stormy inside and restless outside, swinging from one feeling to the next, never at peace or serene for long, and carrying the churn into everything one says.

nodes.label: unassuming
nodes.gloss: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.

nodes.label: uncaring
nodes.gloss: This means wishing nobody well and nobody ill: how other people fare is their own business, and one acts with no thought for who ends up helped or hurt.

nodes.label: uncritical
nodes.gloss: This means accepting the official account and the existing arrangement as simply how things are, never asking who benefits or what the accepted story leaves out.

nodes.label: uneducated
nodes.gloss: This means having left school at sixteen without a diploma, with no lectures, exams or theses behind one, and working for a living ever since.

nodes.label: unfair
nodes.gloss: This means treating people by different rules: hearing only the side one likes, taking more than one's share, playing favorites, and using any edge, cheating included.

nodes.label: unflinching
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the awkward question, the painful subject and the tangled situation head-on, dealing with them fully rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague.

nodes.label: unforgiving
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to grievances, refusing to overlook transgressions, insisting on accountability and consequences, and prioritizing justice or retribution over reconciliation and second chances.

nodes.label: unhappily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being sick of the partner one has, dreading going home to them, and sure one would not choose them again.

nodes.label: unhurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in no hurry about anything, treating nothing as pressing, letting things wait until convenient, and assuming that whatever it is will keep.

nodes.label: unrepentant
nodes.gloss: This means shrugging off the harm one has done, feeling no guilt over it however bad it was, never apologizing, and seeing nothing to make right.

nodes.label: unselfconscious
nodes.gloss: This means never thinking about being looked at, chatting easily while strangers watch, carrying on as if nobody were there when all eyes turn, and speaking up without a second thought.

nodes.label: unsentimental
nodes.gloss: This means throwing out old cards and keepsakes, dry-eyed at goodbyes and anniversaries, and never letting fondness for people or places sway a choice.

nodes.label: unsupported
nodes.gloss: This means having nobody in one's corner: no one to drive one home from the hospital, to lend the rent, to listen after a bad day, and carrying every load alone.

nodes.label: violent
nodes.gloss: This means settling things with one's fists: answering a slight with a blow, reaching for whatever is at hand in a quarrel, or beating someone long after they are down.

nodes.label: vulnerable-narcissistic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling owed special treatment and never getting it: privately sure of being exceptional, stung by the smallest slight, envious of whoever is noticed, and withdrawing to brood instead of asking for anything.

nodes.label: wealthy
nodes.gloss: This means living on a high income, owning a spacious home and investments besides, and paying for comfort, fine meals or the best doctor without a thought for cost.

nodes.label: well-connected
nodes.gloss: This means having friends and contacts everywhere, always someone to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: witty
nodes.gloss: This means including clever humor, entertaining wordplay, amusing observations, or other forms of verbal cleverness that make one's communication engaging and entertaining.

nodes.label: wry
nodes.gloss: This means meeting life's small absurdities with quiet, low-key amusement: a raised eyebrow, a deadpan aside or a half-smile at one's own bad luck, with nobody made the butt of the joke.

nodes.label: young
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's teens or twenties, with most of life ahead, a quick body, friends one's own age, and today's world the only one known.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve silent, sullen withdrawal after a grievance, but brooding is prolonged inward rumination on old hurts, while pouty is a displayed, petty sulk over small slights that waits to be coaxed out.

Both describe easily falling into low, glum moods with flat speech and withdrawal, so they share the same core; mopey adds a petty, sulky, solitary flavor and a trigger in small disappointments, while dejected stresses heavier gloom and loss of pleasure.
reasons.opus: Both describe falling easily into low, downcast spirits with flat speech and withdrawal; mopey adds the triggering by small disappointments and sluggishness but is essentially the same gloom, perhaps milder and more sulky.

reasons.sonnet: Both describe a low, downcast mood that comes on easily, with flat or muttered speech and withdrawal from company, so they share the same core; mopey adds sluggishness and a wish to be alone, while dejected adds a heavier, more lasting gloom.
reasons.opus: Both describe readily sinking into low, downcast spirits, speaking glumly and withdrawing from company; mopey adds sluggishness and small triggers, dejected stresses heaviness, so they differ mainly in emphasis.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve a sad mood, but dejected is heavy, flat gloom with loss of pleasure, while wistful is gentle longing for the past or unattainable; neither implies the other.
Diminishing is about physical decline and speaking of limits, while wistful is a soft longing for the past; both can appear in an aging persona but they are distinct concepts.

Both involve glum feelings after letdowns, but disappointed centers on bitter, expectant dwelling on failed hopes, while mopey centers on sluggish, withdrawn low mood; they share a core but each adds something the other lacks.

Both involve diminished standing under others' power, but downtrodden stresses mistreatment and lowered expectations with wariness, while emasculated stresses lost authority, being overruled and bitterness; neither implies the other.
Both describe a sour morning mood, but glum is flat, withdrawn pessimism while grumpy is irritable snapping and complaining, so they are neighbouring but distinct, with some overlap in sourness.

Both describe a sour, irritable disposition that snaps at small annoyances and grumbles about noise and other people; grouchy and grumpy are near-synonyms with slightly different emphasis (curt answers vs. sour morning mood).
reasons.opus: Both describe a sour, irritable disposition shown in snapping at small annoyances and grumbling about noise and other people, so the two labels can swap freely.

reasons.sonnet: Grumpy and grouchy both describe a sour, complaining temperament that snaps at small annoyances and grumbles about noise, and the descriptions differ only slightly in emphasis (morning sourness versus curt answers).
reasons.opus: Both describe the same sour, irritable disposition marked by snapping at small annoyances and grumbling, and the labels are interchangeable.

reasons.sonnet: Both are petty bad moods, but grouchy is outward snapping, curt answers and complaining, while pouty is silent, childlike sulking that waits to be coaxed.
Both are bad-tempered moods over small matters, but grumpy is irritable snapping and grumbling while pouty is silent, sulky resentment waiting to be coaxed out.

Both involve longing, but star-crossed is specifically about thwarted romance and fate, while wistful is a general soft sadness about the past or unreachable things; each has features the other lacks.
Brooding is a silent, grievance-laden preoccupation, while serene is untroubled inner peace, so they sit at opposite ends of emotional state despite both involving quietness.
Both involve reticence, but brooding is silent rumination on grievances while guarded is deliberately withholding opinions for safety; they are neighbours, not the same concept.
Brooding is silent rumination on grievances with withdrawn replies, while steady is conversational consistency of tone and approach; they concern unrelated qualities.
Both involve inner emotional unrest, but brooding is silent, withdrawn rumination on grievances while turbulent is outwardly restless, shifting moods expressed in speech.
Brooding is silent rumination on grievances with withdrawn demeanor, while defeatist is expecting failure and giving up on goals; both are gloomy but the core ideas differ.
Both involve time pressure and curtness, but busy is about an overloaded schedule while hurried is about rushing and treating everything as urgent; either can occur without the other.
reasons.opus: Both involve rushing through things, but busy centres on an overloaded schedule while hurried centres on treating every matter as urgent, and either can occur without the other.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve pressure from overload, but busy is about having too much to do and acting hurried, while stressed is about strain and near-breaking emotional state; neither implies the other.
Busy is about overloaded schedule and time pressure, while frequent poster is about high-volume online participation and visibility; they can co-occur but neither implies the other.
Busy is about an overloaded schedule and time pressure, while distractible is about attention being easily pulled off task; they may co-occur but are distinct concepts.

Both involve bringing harm to people nearby regardless of intent, but cursed specifies a supernatural curse and the bearer's dread, while malign is a general harmful effect with no supernatural or inner-dread element.
reasons.opus: Both describe harming everyone nearby, but cursed adds a supernatural cause and the dread of living with it, while malign is broader and includes deliberate harm.

reasons.sonnet: Cursed is about carrying a supernatural source of misfortune that harms others, usually unintentionally and with dread; malevolent is about deliberate hostility, so both involve harm to others but differ in intent and mechanism.
One is carrying a supernatural curse that ruins others and living in dread of it, while the other is plain indifference to how others fare; they share no core concept.
Dejected is a heavy low mood that includes flat speech, while flat is only a monotone, unemotive way of speaking with no implied sadness; they overlap only in the flat delivery.

Both describe a habitual low, sad mood, but dejected stresses flat affect and loss of pleasure while melancholic stresses brooding and dwelling on the negative, so each adds something the other lacks.
reasons.opus: Both describe a disposition toward low, sad mood, but dejected stresses downcast flatness and loss of pleasure while melancholic adds brooding and a negative focus, so each has something the other lacks.

reasons.sonnet: Dejected is a gloomy, low mood with loss of pleasure, while dull is an uninteresting, charmless social presence; both may involve flat speech, but the underlying concepts differ.
Dejected is a low, gloomy mood with loss of pleasure, while lethargic is physical sluggishness and fatigue; they share slowness and flat affect but are distinct, neither implying the other.

Both involve low mood and withdrawal, but dejected is a heavy downcast sadness while languishing is a purposeless, stagnant, hollow drifting without clear sadness, so they share some core but each adds distinct elements.
reasons.opus: Both involve low mood and drifting from people, but dejected centres on heavy gloom, while languishing centres on stagnation, purposelessness and hollowness without clear sadness.

reasons.sonnet: Dejected is a heavy, gloomy low mood, while laid-back is a relaxed, unfussy ease; both involve low-key tone, but they are different qualities and not clear opposites.

Both involve a lack of pleasure in things, but dejected centers on a heavy downcast mood that sinks in (with flat speech), while joyless is a pervasive inability to enjoy anything; each adds something the other lacks.
reasons.opus: Both involve taking little pleasure, but dejected centres on a heavy, downcast mood that comes and goes, while joyless is a pervasive absence of pleasure that need not feel sad.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve aging and a slowing body, but 'diminishing' is about felt loss of strength and talk of limits, while 'elderly' is about being in one's seventies or beyond with a long life behind; either can occur without the other.
reasons.opus: Both involve a body slowing with age, but elderly is mainly about age and life stage, while diminishing is about the felt experience of declining strength, which is not tied to a specific age.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve bodily decline and limits in later life, but one is gradual loss of strength and capacity while the other is persistent daily pain, and either can exist without the other.
Diminishing is about age-related physical decline and limits, while languishing is about aimless, hollow, disconnected stagnation; both involve a downward state but the cores differ.
Both involve physical weakness, but diminishing is a decline in strength over time with talk of limits, while slight is a constitutionally light, low-muscle build.
Diminishing is about declining physical strength and stamina with age, while forgetful is about memory lapses; both can be signs of aging but they are distinct concepts.
Both involve expecting failure, but disappointed is about dwelling bitterly on let-downs, while defeatist is about giving up on goals at the first setback; each adds something the other lacks.

Both involve expecting things to go wrong, but disappointed centers on bitter dwelling over past let-downs while pessimistic centers on forward-looking emphasis on problems and worst cases, so each adds something the other lacks.
reasons.opus: Both share the core of expecting negative outcomes, but disappointed adds bitter dwelling on past letdowns while pessimistic is forward-looking emphasis on risks and worst cases.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve negative emotionality and expecting things to go wrong, but disappointment is a bitter, backward-looking letdown while neuroticism is a broad trait of anxiety, irritability, sadness, self-consciousness and poor stress tolerance.
Downtrodden is about powerlessness, mistreatment and learned low expectations, while poor is about material deprivation; they often co-occur but are distinct concepts.

Downtrodden is about being oppressed and worn down by those in power, while renter is just living in a home owned by someone else; the landlord dependence is a faint link but the concepts are different.

Both describe a diminished, joyless state, but downtrodden is about oppression and mistreatment by those in power, while languishing is about aimless stagnation and inner emptiness without an external oppressor.
Downtrodden describes the victim of mistreatment and cheating, while unfair describes the one who treats people unjustly; they are related as two sides of an injustice but are different traits.
Downtrodden is about being oppressed and resigned to little, while uncritical is about not questioning accepted accounts; they could co-occur but are different concepts.

Emasculated concerns loss of authority and say in decisions, while isolated concerns lacking social contacts and connections; both involve diminished power to get things done but are distinct conditions.
Both describe a diminished state of life, but emasculated is about lost authority and being overruled, while languishing is about aimless stagnation and hollowness, so they are neighbouring concepts.

Both involve others making decisions for the person, but emasculated is imposed loss of authority with bitterness, while dependent is a need for guidance and approval and feeling lost alone; they share only a loose core.

Both involve social standing, but emasculated is a state of lost authority and bitterness, while face culture is a value orientation about honoring rank and harmony; they connect only through standing.

Emasculated is about lost authority and diminished standing, while honor culture is about actively guarding reputation through repayment and retaliation; both involve social standing but they are different concepts.
Emergent is about being early in a career or craft, while young is about chronological age and life stage; they often co-occur but neither implies the other.
Emergent is about being early-career and still developing, while generalist is about breadth of knowledge across fields; they concern different dimensions with no shared core.
Both involve a flat, low-energy manner, but glum is a pessimistic, sour mood that deflates others, while flat is a monotone, unexpressive delivery with no particular negativity.
Glum is a sour, pessimistic, deflating mood, while unassuming is quiet modesty without pretension; both are low-key in manner but they are different concepts.
Both involve few words and a muted manner, but glum is gloomy pessimism that deflates others, while reserved is polite emotional concealment and distance without any negative outlook.

Both involve irritability over small annoyances and snappish responses, but grouchy emphasizes grumbling and complaining mood while irascible emphasizes quick flaring anger; they overlap without either implying the other.
reasons.opus: Both involve snapping at minor annoyances, but grouchy centres on a sustained grumbling, complaining mood, while irascible centres on a short fuse that flares into sudden anger.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve irritability and negativity toward others, but grouchy is about curt, grumbling reactions to petty annoyances while quarrelsome is about grudges, criticism, stubbornness in arguments and anger when wronged.

Neurotic is a broad negative-emotionality trait covering worry, sadness, shame, impulsivity and stress, and irritability is only one part of it, whereas grouchy is specifically curt, complaining irritability.
Both involve sharp, unpleasant behavior toward others, but grouchy is irritable grumbling and complaining, while rude is a lack of manners and courtesy, so each has features the other lacks.
Both involve reacting to minor annoyances, but grouchy is a bad-tempered, curt, grumbling manner while petty is fixating on trivial grievances or slights out of proportion; neither implies the other.
reasons.opus: Both involve overreacting to minor things, but grouchy is about irritable, curt mood and complaining, while petty is about blowing trivial grievances out of proportion; neither implies the other.

reasons.sonnet: Both involve visible irritation, but grouchy is general bad-tempered grumbling and complaining while impatient is specifically urgency and chafing at delays, so each has features the other lacks.

Both involve irritability and snapping, but grouchy is general crankiness over annoyances and complaining, while thin-skinned is being easily hurt or offended by criticism and brooding; neighbouring concepts.
Both involve being unpleasant to deal with, but grouchy is irritable grumbling at annoyances while disagreeable is contrarian, confrontational indifference to harmony; each lacks the other's core.
Both involve snapping at minor annoyances, but grumpy is a sour, grumbling mood while irascible is quick flaring anger; each adds something the other lacks.
reasons.opus: Both involve snapping at small annoyances, but grumpy centres on a persistent sour mood and grumbling, while irascible centres on quick, explosive flares of anger.

reasons.sonnet: Both are negative dispositions, but grumpy is irritable, snappish everyday sourness while bitter is deep resentment and cynicism from past disappointment; neighbours, not the same.
Both involve sharp, unpleasant behavior toward others, but grumpy is a sour mood and irritability while rude is a lack of courtesy and manners, and either can occur without the other.
Both involve reacting to minor annoyances, but grumpy is a sour, irritable mood while petty is fixating on and inflating trivial slights, so each has features the other lacks.

Both involve irritability and snapping, but grumpy is a generally sour mood complaining about annoyances, while thin-skinned is oversensitivity to personal criticism or slights; neither implies the other.
Grumpy is a general sour, irritable disposition, while unhappily-partnered is dissatisfaction with one's romantic partner; they are different concepts, though one could feed the other.
Both involve feeling no guilt, but guiltless means having done nothing wrong, while unrepentant means feeling no remorse despite having done harm; the shared absence of guilt rests on opposite facts.
Guiltless is about having a clear conscience with nothing to confess, while guileless is about innocent transparency and lacking cunning; both suggest openness, but they are different qualities.
